spec2def(hdwwiz.cpl hdwwiz.spec)
file(GLOB hdwwiz_rc_deps resources/*.*)
add_rc_deps(hdwwiz.rc ${hdwwiz_rc_deps})

# hdwwiz.cpl is all Rust (hdwwiz-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/hdwwiz-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# hdwwiz.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/hdwwiz-rust/src/hdwwiz/hdwwiz.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(hdwwiz_res OBJECT hdwwiz.rc)
target_compile_definitions(hdwwiz_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(hdwwiz_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(HDWWIZ_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a)
add_cargo_module(hdwwiz hdwwiz-cargo hdwwiz.cpl
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE hdwwiz-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS hdwwiz_res ${HDWWIZ_REUSED})
